# Di Dee Designers

> Di Dee Designers is a saree pre-pleating and box folding service in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, India. It prepares a customer's own saree in advance - pleated and box-folded - so it can be worn quickly without arranging pleats by hand. Silk, bridal and delicate sarees are handled, with scheduled pickup and delivery across Tiruppur, Avinashi and Erode.

## Services and prices (per saree, INR)
- Saree pre-pleating and box folding: from Rs 250
- Silk and bridal saree care: from Rs 300
- Custom pleating and styling: from Rs 400
- Also: scheduled pickup and delivery, family and bulk preparation, express preparation (subject to availability)
